The house of
Al Arabian

Al Arabian Fragrance makes attars and perfumes from the notes people reach for most: oud, musk, rose and saffron.

Attars come in 10 ml and 12 ml bottles that are easy to carry. The eau de parfum range comes in 50 ml and 60 ml.

Every fragrance comes in its own printed box, ready to gift.

  1. Pick a fragrance in the collection.

Which sizes are available?

Attars come in 10 ml and 12 ml. Eau de parfum comes in 50 ml (White Gold 360) and 60 ml (Royal Fresh).

Can you help me choose?

Yes. Message us what you like to smell and we will suggest a fragrance.

How do I pay and get delivery?

Ask us on WhatsApp and we will share the details for your city.
